claim: The lowest-confidence reasoning step predicts chain-of-thought failure better than any average confidence measure.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by collecting confidence scores for each reasoning step in a chain-of-thought and comparing the predictive power of the minimum step confidence against the average confidence for predicting task failure.

conditions: in empirical evaluations of chain-of-thought reasoning
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the specific empirical study reported in 2024; transfer to other reasoning tasks or models is unestablished.

title: Lowest-confidence reasoning step–chain-of-thought failure principle
